## Verdict sources
- verdict_class = xcmp.py transition, final round (PRE -> post_d, IEEE model column + SVVL column, verbatim) from
  r3_x_c_pre.out (g/c), r3_x_newc_pre.out (g/newc, g/c2, g/c3 aliases), r3_x_lens_diff_pre.out
  (r1/differential/c D*, g/lens/diff), r3_x_lens_sound_pre.out (r1/soundness/cells, g/lens/sound). A cell not printed
  as a mover gets `same` quoted from the IEEE tally line ("97 same" etc.); verdict_source points at that line.
- r1/differential/c R3* (10 cells, round-3 differential): r1/differential/REPORT.md:33-36 (short verbatim phrase).
- r3/soundness/cells: r3/soundness/REPORT.md section headings (BLOCKING B-1 :4, MAJOR M-1 :10, MINOR test gaps :14).
- notes column: "named at <file>:<line>" = first line of the lens REPORT / COMMIT_DOCS.txt / IMPL.md naming the cell.
- Earlier-round tables (post_b, post_c, postd2, postd4, grounding P4/P6 classes) are manifested as verdict_table rows
  but not used for verdict_class.
